subject: Offer: Emilia Carter — revised template & conditional start
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Offer for Emilia Carter — initial draft & conditional start

Hi team,

Attaching the first-pass offer for Emilia Carter (BrightAI). Quick summary:
- Role: Senior ML Engineer, IC4
- Proposed base: $205,000
- Target equity: 0.35% (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff)
- Signing bonus: $15,000 (one-time)
- Proposed start: 2026-07-20 (candidate prefers late July)

Note: Emilia is completing a shortvisa transfer and expects work authorization to be confirmed by late July. Legal asked that we include a conditional start clause referencing proof of right-to-work and background check completion. I drafted the clause in the attached template (EmiliaCarter_OfferTemplate_v1.pdf).

Asks: 1) Please confirm final base and equity band for sign-off (I put her at the top of IC4 band). 2) Any objections to the conditional-start language as written? 3) Marcus — do you want the start moved to early August to give additional ramp time for security onboarding?

I will hold the DocuSign envelope until we lock the base/equity.

Thanks,
Olga
Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: EmiliaCarter_OfferTemplate_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer for Emilia Carter — initial draft & conditional start

Thanks for the draft, Olga — looks good overall. A few quick redline items from compensation and legal POV:

- Base: Can we move to $210,000? Emilia's counter and market signals put her at the top quartile; pushing to $210k keeps us competitive while staying inside the approved IC4 band.
- Equity: Keep 0.35% but please add explicit post-termination acceleration language only for change-of-control (standard 12-month clause).
- Signing bonus: fine as-is but make it payable in two installments (50% at start, 50% after 6 months) to protect against immediate attrition.
- Conditional start clause: Legal suggests wording: "Start date is contingent on verification of eligibility to work in the U.S. and completion of standard background checks. If verification is not complete by the agreed start date, the company may postpone the start date at its discretion." Please include that exact sentence.
- Start date: I prefer we default to 2026-08-03 to allow time for access provisioning (security, VPN). If candidate asks for late July, we can make it flexible.

Marcus — any issue with the elevated base? If not, I approve moving forward with these redlines.

- Lauren
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Revised Offer — Emilia Carter (please review & sign)

Hi Emilia,

Great speaking with you last week. Attached is the revised offer for Senior ML Engineer at Redwood Inference. Highlights of the changes you should expect from the earlier conversation:

- Base salary: $210,000
- Equity: 0.35% (4-year vesting schedule, 1-year cliff; change-of-control acceleration per standard policy)
- Signing bonus: $15,000 (50% at start, 50% after 6 months)
- Start date: proposed 2026-08-03 (were happy to accommodate a July 27 start if you can complete notice / authorization by then)

Please review the attached offer (EmiliaCarter_OfferTemplate_v2.pdf). I have included the conditional-start language required by our legal team: "Start date is contingent on verification of eligibility to work in the U.S. and completion of standard background checks. If verification is not complete by the agreed start date, the company may postpone the start date at its discretion."

Next steps: If everything looks good, sign via the DocuSign link below and well send the final signed copy and onboarding checklist. Ill hold the first day provisional until final authorization is confirmed.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345-EMILIA
Attachment: EmiliaCarter_OfferTemplate_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Let me know if youd like to discuss any of the terms — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com

From: Emilia Carter <emilia@brightai.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BrightAI HR <hr@brightai.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T14:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised Offer — Emilia Carter (please review & sign)

Hi Olga — thank you, and excited about the offer. I reviewed the updated terms and everything looks correct. Two quick items:

1) Start date: I have a final week of commitments at BrightAI and would prefer to start the week of July 27 if thats acceptable. I should be able to complete my notice and authorization by July 24. If HR needs the 8/03 buffer, I understand — please let me know whether July 27 is doable.
2) Is the first 50% of the signing bonus paid on the first payroll or as a separate lump sum? Just want to plan expected cash flow.

I clicked the DocuSign link and electronically signed the offer; please let me know when you have the fully executed copy. Looking forward to joining Redwood.

Best,
Emilia Carter
Senior Research Engineer, BrightAI
emilia@brightai.com
